subject: Business Models
title: Surge Pricing Ethics
description: A 60-second lesson on Surge Pricing Ethics.

hook.text: During Hurricane Sandy, Uber prices surged 8x. A $20 ride cost $160. Public outrage erupted.

buildup.text: Surge pricing uses supply-demand economics: high demand and low supply drives prices up automatically.

discovery.text: Economists defend surge pricing: higher prices attract more drivers, actually increasing supply during crises.

twist.text: The public sees it as price gouging. Uber caps surge at 2x during natural disasters now.

climax.text: The tension between economic efficiency and public perception defines dynamic pricing's future.

punchline.text: 8x during a hurricane. Efficient or exploitative? The debate rages.

quiz.question: How does Uber now handle surge pricing during natural disasters?
